description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the first screen shown to new users, requesting location permissions. It displays UI elements including icons, texts, and a button that requests permissions and navigates to the second screen.

classes.name: FirstScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the initial screen for new users, requesting location permissions.

classes.name: _FirstScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and behavior of FirstScreen, including permission requests and navigation.

methods.name: _buildPermissionItem
methods.description: Builds a row widget displaying an icon and descriptive text for a permission item.

methods.name: _handleAllowPermissions
methods.description: Handles the tap event for the permission button, initiates permission request, saves a flag, and navigates to the second screen.

methods.name: _requestPermissionsAndNavigate
methods.description: Performs the permission check/request and navigates to the SecondScreen.
